active_goal: Continue Phase 4 P4.1 reference-runtime validation from the published dev1 Preview without changing renderer source until runtime evidence justifies a new correction.
scope_boundary: Active engineering scope is Phase 4 P4.1 shadow large-scene GPU visibility plus repository/AI continuity maintenance. facts.text: Phase 3 is complete; Phase 4 P4.1 is active and intentionally shadow-only, with the validated P3.10 path still owning production terrain rendering.
Repository hygiene is active and proven; the normal steady state is main plus active PR branches, with a target of no more than five branches.
The public tester channel for development binaries is GitHub Prerelease / Preview; v0.4.0-phase4-dev1 is published as a Preview.

decisions.text: Native Vulkan interop stays narrow; Minecraft continues to own the Vulkan device, queues, submission lifecycle, swapchain/presentation, and normal graphics passes unless a separately evidenced decision changes that boundary.
main is the only permanent branch; branches are disposable working state and history belongs in attempts, PRs, exact SHAs, tags, and releases.

LLM context is tiered and recoverable; compact summaries are non-authoritative indexes, critical knowledge must survive compaction, and external calls/OAuth authorization are limited to task-necessary data and least-privilege scopes.
